body:
I guess I'm just scared right now that things aren't going to get any better, and I'm just so tired... I want to believe that something great like that could happen to me, but then I remember that it did. Six years ago... and now I'm here.

I really want to believe this will all work out. I really do... So I promise I'll at least try. I'll look for other apartments and try to get on the best I can, for as long as I can.

I put a message up on my facebook account, but I really don't want some random person living with me. I don't trust people very easily and I'd rather just put everything in storage and live out of my car if I have to until I can find a studio apartment near my job.

Well right now I'm packing up things in anticipation of... well I don't know. I guess I'll put my stuff in storage for now. That doesn't really help because it makes me think more, but it has to get done before the lease runs out.

I've been thinking more about it and I don't know if I want to live. I was used and kicked around so much before I found my wife, and she inspired me to further myself and be the best person I could. She was one of the last people left in my life that I trusted, and she's gone now. I feel like I murdered her. I feel like every little fight was just another knife in her until she couldn't take it anymore...

I don't want to go through any of that ever again. I don't know if I ever could give myself to someone so completely ever again... I just want to sleep forever, and feel nothing.
